To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(i) the best motion descriptors for human detection in films and videos are oriented histograms of differential optical flows, and (ii) the best combination of appearance and motion descriptors is the appearance descriptor of Dalal and Triggs combined with the best motion descriptor.
Oriented Histograms (OH) of differential optical flow (DOF) are the best motion descriptors for human detection, and that OHs of DOF and appearance descriptors are complementary.
